en.headline: Foreign man injured in knife attack in Lok Ma Chau
en.dek: A 29-year-old man was wounded in the leg by two assailants on Monday night; police are searching for the suspects and have classified the case as wounding.
body: A 29-year-old foreign man was injured in a knife attack on Kam Pok Road West in Lok Ma Chau on Monday night, police said.
The victim was attacked by two people with a knife and sustained a leg injury. He was taken conscious to Pok Oi Hospital for treatment.
Police classified the case as wounding. No arrests have been made and officers are hunting for the two suspects.

zh.headline: 落馬洲外籍男子遭刀襲 腿部受傷
zh.dek: 29歲外籍男子周一晚在落馬洲金博路西被兩人持刀襲擊，腿部受傷，清醒送往博愛醫院，案件列傷人，警方正緝捕疑犯。
body: 警方表示，一名29歲外籍男子周一晚在落馬洲金博路西遭刀襲。
事主被兩人持刀襲擊，腿部受傷，清醒送往博愛醫院治理。
案件列傷人，暫無人被捕，警方正追緝兩名疑犯。
